purpose: Teach: 倭/弌/丙/鉉/辺野古/住専/フジサンケイビジネスアイ/日本経済新聞社
target_vocab: フジサンケイビジネスアイ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業者の倭風、つまり倭時代の精神を社員に伝えろ
lines.en: I want our founding spirit—the values of the Wa era—communicated throughout the company.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Slight weight on 'founding spirit.' Deliberate pacing. The tone of someone stating a principle, not debating it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧字「弌」、つまり一を社印デザインに残します
lines.en: Understood. We'll preserve the old character for 'one' in our company seal design.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient acknowledgment. Crisp delivery on 'understand.' Calm confirmation—demonstrating he's already thinking through the implementation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、機密書類は丙、つまり丙号級まで厳重に管理しろ
lines.en: Sensitive documents must be handled with strict classification controls up to the highest tier.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no softening. Even tempo. The weight of responsibility in each phrase. Professional, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古美術の鉉、つまり鉉の鼎を会議室に飾ります
lines.en: Understood. We'll display that classical bronze tripod in the conference room.
lines.style: Steady, assured response. Light nod in the voice. Showing competence—he knows what's needed and how to execute it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、辺野古周辺の事業に慎重に対応しろ
lines.en: Handle our operations near Henoko with careful attention. This needs discretion.
lines.style: Lowered intensity but heightened seriousness. Slight pause before the sensitive location name. A quiet warning underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。住専、つまり住宅金融の動向を経営に反映します
lines.en: Understood. I'll track housing finance trends and brief management accordingly.
lines.style: Efficient, detail-oriented. Quick on the uptake—showing he understands both the explicit and implicit weight of the directive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、フジサンケイビジネスアイに新製品の広告を出せ
lines.en: Place an advertisement for the new product in the Fuji Sankei Business Eye.
lines.style: Clear directive, specific publication named with precision. Professional tempo. The tone of delegating to someone who will execute without requiring clarification.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日本経済新聞社にプレスリリースを送ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll send a press release to the Nikkei.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly firmer than previous responses. Shows full alignment. Brief, professional close—acknowledgment and commitment in equal measure.
